description: One activity in detail: distance, times, pace (per km and mile), speed, HR, cadence, running dynamics, power, training effect and load, temperature, RPE/feel, and split summaries (warm-up/active/cool-down totals, not per-km; use get_activity_analysis for km/mile splits and laps). detail='full' returns Garmin's raw record (200+ fields).

detail.description: compact (default) keeps the meaningful fields in readable units; full returns Garmin's raw payload.

name: get_activity
title: Activity detail
